name: Virunga VR
summary:
Step into the heart of eastern DR Congo with Virunga VR, a peaceful, narrative-driven exploration of the Habinyanja–Bukima sector of Virunga National Park. Designed for mindful discovery, the experience features no combat, fail states, or scores, allowing you to absorb the breathtaking natural beauty and wildlife of a real-world sanctuary at your own pace.

Beginning inside a rustic ranger cabin, choose your path from three distinct, fully voice-guided activities in English and French:
